title: Weekly Overview: Finalizing Project Scope with Supervisor Nenina
text: Hello, this is Liam in for Komal. Madison weekly, the team locked scope with Nina chose CVAT over building annotation from scratch, lined up 3 weeks of build work, kept collecting free images, and Komal opened a second track on brand frameworks for Madison tools. First move this week, finalize the project scope, then turn it into milestones. That plan went to Nina, the supervisor, so everyone is looking at the same map before the build accelerates. Before the timeline stuck, one alignment question. Option A, build an end-to-end tool, annotate, manage data sets, prep training data, detect wildlife. Option B, use an existing annotator like CVAT and spend limited hands on models in the workflow gaps.

title: The Build vs. Borrow Dilemma: Why CVAT Won the Selection
text: Open source already does annotation well. The team had to pick. Decision, option B. CVAT owns annotation. The development team focuses on machine learning models and the rest of the workflow that does not already have a strong open source answer. Building the whole platform from scratch is not the best use of limited hands right now. With CVAT slotted in the near plan stays. Week one, lovable demo, GitHub repo, confirm the stack. Week two, scalable project structure in the design document. Week three, first core feature, likely frame extraction or frame annotation. Full project plan hardens once the scope stays locked. In

title: Mapping the 3-Week Build Plan: Prototypes, Docs, and Frame Extraction
text: Parallel, the team kept collecting more free licensed images to help train the model. Provenance still matters. Free is not the same as free to train without a trail. Second track, Komal is drafting framework ideas for marketing and brand tools under Madison. Young and archetypes, big five, MBTI, enneagram, values, Maslow, diffusion, Aaker, story brand, jobs to be done. Next Madison meeting picks a direction, then she writes the detailed feature plan. Let's recap with Claude. Scope and milestones went to Nina. The fork was build everything versus borrow annotation.

title: Gathering Free-Licensed Imagery: Navigating the Provenance Trail
text: Option B one, CVAT plus models and workflow. Weeks one through three are queued. Images keep coming. Brand frameworks land next meeting. Design judgement, don't rebuild what CVaT already solved. Your turn. Paste this into Claude for your own build. I have an open source annotator candidate and a custom end-to-end idea. Force a build versus borrow decision. List what the existing tool already does well, what it never will, and where my limited team hours should go in the next 3 weeks. Flag any ego project that duplicates a solved problem. Run it before you write another milestone. Madison weekly scope locked. Lay them in for Komal.
